# BIG (long): accepts strings that contain the pattern 0110100110010110 somewhere.
# The machine 'guesses' where the pattern starts, then follows a 16-step chain.
# 17 states in a long line. Try 'Fit to screen' and zooming in.
alphabet: 0, 1
states: p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14, p15, p16
start: p0
accepting: p16

rule: p0 -- 0 --> p0
rule: p0 -- 1 --> p0
rule: p0 -- 0 --> p1
rule: p1 -- 1 --> p2
rule: p2 -- 1 --> p3
rule: p3 -- 0 --> p4
rule: p4 -- 1 --> p5
rule: p5 -- 0 --> p6
rule: p6 -- 0 --> p7
rule: p7 -- 1 --> p8
rule: p8 -- 1 --> p9
rule: p9 -- 0 --> p10
rule: p10 -- 0 --> p11
rule: p11 -- 1 --> p12
rule: p12 -- 0 --> p13
rule: p13 -- 1 --> p14
rule: p14 -- 1 --> p15
rule: p15 -- 0 --> p16
rule: p16 -- 0 --> p16
rule: p16 -- 1 --> p16
